name: Immovable Thong
description: Keep the thong drawn almost taut across the body so any weapon that touches it is felt at once.

name: Flickthrash
description: Jerk the handle back sharply so the thong snaps taut and the tip lands on the mark.

name: Mightlash
description: Step onto the same narrow line as the thong so the body presents only its edge to the foe.

name: Verity Whiptail
description: Read the thong's hum as it tightens and learn exactly when the snap will come.

name: Tempered Tether
description: Gather qi into the last span of the thong as it snaps so the tip pierces a padded coat.

name: Manacling Lash
description: Snap the thong back against a sword hand just as the grip tires and strip the weapon free.

name: Facetlash
description: Drive a narrow thread of qi down the snapping line so that it bores through a shield face.

name: Blazethong
description: Time the snap so qi peaks at the tip and the whip cleanly cuts through a rope or leather strap.

name: Plaitgreave
description: Spin the thong in a wide ring around the body so that nothing can close from any side.

name: Iron Whipstock
description: Throw the lash in a wide flat arc that sweeps across the whole front at chest height.

name: Silt Fall
description: Run in a long curve across open ground while trailing the thong at the flank of the pursuers.

name: Fortifying Popper
description: Hold the thong low and tally by its trembling how many are closing and from which sides.

name: Rumbleflick
description: Throw the thong back over the shoulder to strike a pursuer without turning the head.

name: Might Keeper
description: Cut through the legs of the nearest foes in one low pass that leaves the rest hesitant.

name: Hourthong
description: Crack the thong in a rapid circle around the body so that the din holds the crowd at bay.

name: Thorn Furl
description: Loop the thong around a runner's arm as one passes and let their own speed pull them over.

name: Slag Plait
description: Swing a qi-charged arc across a loose line of foes so that each is touched by the passing tip.

name: Lotplait
description: Run a looping path that chains cast then wrap then cut against three foes in turn without stopping.

name: Facet Lashend
description: Sit firm in the saddle or the crouch with the thong coiled to the side ready for either hand.

name: Might Flick
description: Throw the very long thong from above the head so that it falls on the target like a dropped rope.

name: Flickspurt
description: Time each running stride with a cast so that the lash lands as the lead foot touches.

name: Keeper Linctus
description: Fix the eye on a distant rider and feel the thong's length against the gap to be crossed.

name: Toxin Popcrack
description: Hook a passing rider's rein with the tip and pull sharply so the mount shies and throws its seat.

name: Hoarfrost Snap
description: Wrap the rider's waist with the long thong and heave so that the rider leaves the saddle.

name: Furltorment
description: Crack the long thong just in front of an enemy mount to turn it from its line.

name: Skinning Popper
description: Spread the qi field along the thong and let it carry the tip far past the whip's normal range.

name: Thornflick
description: Wrap a distant foe and haul in hand over hand while the qi field keeps the line from parting.

name: Mighttether
description: Push from the rear heel through hip and shoulder so that the lash is thrown by the whole body.

name: Scything Tether
description: Whip the hips around first so that the arm and the thong trail the turn like a tail.

name: Facet Lashcore
description: Ripple the spine so the thong flows around the back and shoulders and covers each side in turn.

name: Fallleap
description: Plant the lead foot as the cast leaves the hand so that the stroke is braced against the ground.

name: Waning Whipheel
description: Gather breath and weight into the lower belly and feel the thong's pull in the soles of the feet.

name: Keeperhauberk
description: Roll the shoulder under the thong so that its coils slide a cutting blade off the body.

name: Might Thong
description: Twist the torso in a full spiral and release the lash at the end of the turn for added snap.

name: Fastening Lashend
description: Cast the coil so that it opens in the air and drops over a foe's shoulders and arms.

name: Might Popcrack
description: Leap from a crouch and let the thong whip down from the height of the jump.

name: Sanguine Whipheel
description: Unwind the whole body from heel to fingertip through the thong so that a single stroke hits with its full mass.

name: Fallcuirass
description: Send the thong in a wide orbit around the whole body with qi in the field to turn aside arrows.

name: Granite Fall
description: Hold one handle in each fist with the thongs crossed at the wrists to cover the chest.

name: Blaze Flick
description: The left lash goes out first to draw the guard while the right hand waits.

name: Granite Whiptail
description: Follow the lead stroke with the right lash on a lower line so the first block leaves the second open.

name: Keepersprint
description: Step forward with both lashes trailing evenly so that neither side of the body is left bare.

name: Chime Plait
description: Rest both thongs along the ground and sweep the eyes like a hawk over the whole field.

name: Murk Whipstock
description: Cross both thongs in front of the face to catch a falling blade at the crossing.

name: Sanguine Furl
description: Raise one lash high and drop it onto the target with a diving snap of qi.

name: Fastening Snap
description: Throw both thongs in opposite spirals around a foe's arm and leg so that the pair lock together.

name: Tempered Lash
description: Cut with both lashes in an X so the paths cross exactly on the chest of the target.

name: Skinning Lashcore
description: Crack both thongs in alternating beats so the sound seems to come from every side.

name: Compounding Doctrine Whiptail
description: Pin the weapon arm with one lash and bring the second down in a hawk stoop on the exposed neck.

name: Gust Thong
description: Raise both lashes with a slow breath of gathered qi then bring them down together like two hawks diving.

name: Aegis Whipheel
description: Stand with a thong circling in each hand like water turning at the rim of a bowl.

name: Mightpopper
description: Draw the left thong across the body so that its tail flicks at the foe's far shoulder.

name: Silt Plait
description: Walk forward in a gentle curve with both thongs flowing behind like a river around a bend.

name: Nursing Fall
description: Compare the pull in each hand to know which side the foe is leaning toward.

name: Staunch Lashend
description: Swirl the thongs together in a small basin and sweep the incoming blade round and out of it.

name: Popper Torment
description: Send one lash after the other in a flowing current so that the rhythm never breaks.

name: Gyve Keeper
description: Spin both thongs round a weapon like an eddy and draw it down into the centre.

name: Resilient Popper
description: Keep both thongs turning in a closed circuit fed by qi so that no blow can enter the swirl.

name: Ravaging Granite Popcrack
description: Burst both thongs outward together so a flood of qi-edged lash sweeps every foe in front.

name: Aegis Lashcore
description: Stand with the thong flowing out to the side like a stream along a bank.

name: Might Snap
description: Throw the lash in a bending line that curves around the guard just before it lands.

name: Siltflick
description: Cross the line of the attack in three short steps like picking across a ford.

name: Remnant Whipstock
description: Let the thong lie in a loose curve and listen to the faint sounds it picks up from the ground.

name: Unmaking Lash
description: Skip the thong tip along the ground in two small bounds before it rises to sting the shin.

name: Granite Whipheel
description: Pour qi into the thong at its first curve so that the force gathers and spills out at the tip.

name: Paralyzing Tether
description: Throw a long looping curve that closes like an oxbow around the neck of a weapon.

name: Murkfall
description: Meet the blade with the fast part of the thong's curve and carry it off downstream.

name: Hourflick
description: Run a single stroke through three successive bends so that it cuts then wraps then snaps home.

name: Cleaving Flick
description: Gather qi over a slow count and release a broad surge along the whole thong that batters everything before it.

name: Charter Plait
description: Hold the thong so two bands of qi run in it side by side ready for either task.

name: Might Whipstock
description: Throw a clean lash with qi gathered on its leading edge so the stroke lands crisply.

name: Whipping Keeper
description: Step beside the opponent along a parallel line and keep the thong angled across them.

name: Verityplait
description: Feel which of the two tracks of qi in the thong is running stronger and ease the other.

name: Hoarfrost Popcrack
description: Wrap a limb and keep the first track of qi steadily gripping while the hand stays free.

name: Raging Flick
description: Send the second track of qi to the tip for a sharp snap that cuts while the first still holds.

name: Lot Whiptail
description: Fire a single stroke that binds at its middle and cuts at its tip in the same instant.

name: Facet Furl
description: Pierce the guard with one track of qi while the other holds the weapon arm fixed in place.

name: Popperplating
description: Stand with the face to the wind and the thong streaming downwind from the whip hand.

name: Rumble Lashcore
description: Throw the lash on the rising edge of a gust so that the wind adds speed to the stroke.

name: Blurring Snap
description: Step close to the plateau's edge where the wind runs strongest and leave the foe the lee.

name: Heartening Lashend
description: Raise the wet finger and read the strength and the turning of the wind before the cast.

name: Tempered Thong
description: Flick the tip across a crosswind so it drifts onto the target from the side.

name: Implacable Lashcore
description: Let the wind lift the thong into the path of a thrust and push it away.

name: Ravaging Whiptail
description: Pour qi into the thong as a gust hits so the two forces add together.

name: Ponderous Lash
description: Throw a loop into the wind and let it belly out and drop over the foe.

name: Hour Furl
description: Snap the thong against the wind so the sound rolls across the plateau like thunder.

name: Scorching Whipstock
description: Hold qi in the thong while the gust blows and ride the steady wind to stretch the stroke far past its length.

name: Lambasting Fall
description: Whirl the thong in a rising spiral that catches the gale and strikes every foe within the turning.

name: Resilient Lashend
description: Take the stance that names the stroke to come and hold it motionless for one breath.

name: Splintering Snap
description: Throw exactly the stroke that the stance declared and not another.

name: Torrent Furl
description: Take one measured step forward that may not be retreated from until the stroke is finished.

name: Tuned Thong
description: Count a sworn number of breaths while feeling the foe's rhythm through the lowered thong.

name: Fastening Lash
description: Wrap the foe's arm with the pledge that the thong will not be loosed until they yield.

name: Popper Assault
description: Throw a lash that answers the exact blow that was just offered and no more.

name: Torrent Fall
description: Turn aside the blow with the thong held steady like a promise that will not bend.

name: Thongtorment
description: Throw a single stroke that is never retracted or redirected once it has begun and lands with sworn weight.

name: Fallgreave
description: Hold a taut line across the foe's chest and let qi press the breath short until they stand still.

name: Fallelixir
description: Stand square and sight along the thong to take the exact bearing of the opponent.

name: Skinning Flick
description: Throw the lash along the bearing already taken so that it arrives without a hint of wander.

name: Gust Plait
description: Step along a fixed heading that keeps the same angle to the opponent however they move.

name: Plaitplating
description: Lean into the wind with the thong lowered so the gale cannot spin the body off its heading.

name: Sanguine Popcrack
description: Flick the wrist late in the throw to pull a drifting stroke back onto its bearing.

name: Verity Lashend
description: Glance along the thong at the end of each stroke to see that the bearing has not slipped.

name: Granite Flick
description: Aim off the bearing by exactly what the wind will take so that the stroke drifts onto the mark.

name: Rumblelash
description: Hook the foe's weapon arm along the bearing and pull so the strike is dragged off its line.

name: Scalding Lash
description: Crack along the bearing so the sound itself drives a nervous foe off the heading.

name: Staggering Tether
description: Wrap the foe along the held bearing and keep that line taut as they twist.

name: Iron Whipheel
description: Hold the bearing through the gale while qi builds then let go a long cast that drives straight through.

name: Intent Popper
description: Run cast then wrap then pull in one unbroken heading so that each stroke prepares the next.

name: Whipstock Fastness
description: Stand with the thong lifted a little by the air and ready to be driven with the wind.

name: Sanguine Plait
description: Throw the lash only when the thong tells of a clean draft ahead of the tip.

name: Gust Tether
description: Move into the pocket where the wind is weakest so that the thong runs true.

name: Discerning Whiptail
description: Feel faint drafts along the thong that betray a hidden doorway or a foe stepping near.

name: Trouncing Tether
description: Flick the slackened thong into a passing gust that throws it onto a distant mark.

name: Facetthong
description: Pour qi into the thong only where the air runs thin and let the stroke bore forward.

name: Gyvethong
description: Let the wind bend the thong around a foe's limb and then tighten it with a quick qi pull.

name: Equipoise Keeper
description: Raise the thong into a rising gust that swings an arriving blade past the shoulder.

name: Fallassault
description: Find the thin pocket in the foe's guard as in the air and send qi through it in a needle stroke.

name: Thorn Keeper
description: Lay the thong along the ground with qi hidden in it so that a foe who steps across is snared.
